# ThunderStudy AI — Full AI-readable site summary

## Identity
ThunderStudy AI is a free educational AI project run by Wondermayank, a solo student developer building free educational tools since 2018.

## Public pages
- Home: https://ai.thunderstudy.indevs.in/ — central page for the AI study tools and educational experiences.
- About: https://ai.thunderstudy.indevs.in/about.html — mission, ownership, purpose, offerings and contact information.
- FAQ: https://ai.thunderstudy.indevs.in/faq.html — concise questions and answers about the project and its tools.
- Changelog: https://ai.thunderstudy.indevs.in/changelog.html — newest-first project changes labelled Added, Fixed, Improved and Removed.
- Updates: https://ai.thunderstudy.indevs.in/new.html — public copy of the changelog.

## Purpose
ThunderStudy AI provides free educational AI experiences intended to help students study, practise, revise and prepare for competitive exams. The project includes study assistance, AI mindmaps, flashcards, mock-test creation and formula-sheet generation, as described by the public site.
